text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Nice Nature's debut race has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll probably be talking about "the good ol' days" by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haha, appearing relaxed is my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Besides, it's not the debut that matters… it's what comes after it.
choice_data_list: Just go out there and show off what you've been working on!
Just go out there and show off what you've been working on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I'd more than love to do that if I had anything worth showing…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But it wouldn't be a Nice Nature race if I didn't screw up on an important day like this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm sure I'll do just fine! I guess I'd better be off.
